title: Walker and the Cosmos Club

tellings.quote: >> Walker was Walker was one of the one of the people that's one of the things we discovered

plain: The researcher Grant Cameron says a man named Eric A. Walker was one of the people linked to the Cosmos Club, a private club in Washington, D.C., and calls this "one of the things we discovered." He offers it on the show without naming a source and says little more about it. To Cameron it points to the Cosmos Club as a place where people tied to UFO secrecy gathered.
